gearbox.title: Gearbox subassembly (20 tasks) - realistic example
gearbox.notes: Single-stage helical gearbox. One 8-hour shift minus 30 min breaks = 7 h = 25,200 s; demand 360 units/shift gives takt = 70 s. Task times are illustrative standard times (seconds) of the kind a time study produces. The current_station column is the unbalanced as-is line used for the before/after yamazumi.
